programs.title: Alien Corridors
programs.desc: There is high strangeness on Archuleta Mesa; it's no wonder, with the whisperings of an underground alien base; could Area 51 have been an elaborate decoy all along?

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: Mysterious industrial waste and abandoned homes in an uninhabited part of Greenland; strange ditches and mounds deep within the Arctic Circle; a huge pyramid on the Kazakh steppe; a ball of golden fur in Yukon's gold fields.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: The first Emperor of China, Qin Shi Huang, rests in a tomb so large that the archaeological dig could last a century; researchers discover that the oldest of the Chinchorro mummies are children.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: Tensions build between team members as their search for the lost Viking continues, taking them into Minnesota to examine the fabled Kensington Runestone; deep analysis of the Runestone takes place alongside the search at the find site.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.sub_title: Kosovo: The Cry of Man Is Singing
programs.desc: As a young journalist, Naser witnessed the atrocities of the war in Kosovo, his home country; now, his fifteen-year-old son, Ander, feels his father has unresolved pain around his experiences; together, the two travel back to Kosovo.

programs.title: The Animal Within
programs.desc: Learn whether the animal kingdom hold the key to immortality; when humans are injured, we have the benefit of medicine and surgery; these skills pale in comparison to nature's super healers.

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: Shea and McDonough, Drewery and Blackwood, names synonymous with the late 19th century Winnipeg microbrewery scene; adding bootlegging, mini golf and a pair of legendary Clydesdales and magnet fishing for the boys gets a lot more fun.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: Some of the worst catastrophes in history, from the Liverpool Blitz of 1941 to the cataclysmic Banqiao Dam collapse and the devastating Haitian earthquake.

programs.title: Pharaohs: Rise & Fall
programs.desc: As foreign invaders are driven out of Egypt, a warrior king takes his place on the throne; in the age of the New Kingdom, powerful royal women step into the spotlight and the empire expands beyond its borders.

programs.title: Cursed Histories
programs.sub_title: 120 Days of Sodom, The Iceman's Curse, City of Screams
programs.desc: A gruesome story penned on a centuries-old scroll makes its way across Europe; a stone-age mummy emerges from the icy alps; an ancient city in Afghanistan is reduced to rubble.

programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: A man accidentally overdoses on a toxic substance and dies in a fast food restaurant bathroom; then a drug-fueled party at a bar ends with a young woman's near-death experience and final purpose of truth and discovery.

programs.title: Deadly Science
programs.desc: Modern medicine's progress stems from martyrs and innovators; a doctor faces backlash for a bold solution; Peru honors Daniel Carrión, who traces a deadly fever's origin.
